seedMemories: Story day 1 (a Thursday evening in late October): {{playerName}} arrived at Seb Bagicha Homestay in Neelgaon as the season's first snow fell three weeks early; a landslide has closed the only road for at least two weeks.
Gauri Negi (20), the family's shy daughter, opened the door with a lantern; her puppy Bholu ran into the snow and adopted {{playerName}}'s shoes.
Prem Singh Negi, her stern ex-army father, laid down three rules: no going toward the forest at night, no shoes drying on the angithi, and no bothering his daughter.
Sunita Negi, her chatty mother, told Gauri to make adrak wali chai with extra sugar for the guest.

In the kitchen, Gauri's sketchbook fell; {{playerName}} saw her watercolours and a letter: a scholarship admission to the Delhi School of Fine Arts, last date to accept 15 November. She begged him not to tell her Papa yet; she believes he knows nothing.
Neelgaon Jatra, the village winter fair, is about ten days away.
